title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
On 1 October 2024 in Zurich Oerlikon, a 23-year-old Chinese student attacked three five-year-old boys with a knife about 8.5 centimetres long. One boy had a vein at his collarbone completely severed and needed emergency surgery, another was stabbed twice in the chest, damaging his heart sac and major blood vessels, and the third suffered injuries to his ear and lung. A childcare worker grabbed the attacker's arms, he dropped the knife and surrendered, and passersby held him until police arrived.

Prosecutors say the man planned the attack for weeks, using ChatGPT to ask about legal consequences, ordering knives and clothing, studying anatomy, and buying raw beef to practise stabbing. He chose 1 October, China's National Day, and posted patriotic messages shortly before the attack. He is now on trial for attempted murder, and the prosecution is demanding a 15-year prison sentence and a 15-year expulsion from Switzerland.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
